candidate_account.account_policy: Both arms and all three stages share a mechanically bound existing authorized account, exact model/mode and route; no automatic fallback. Provisional family may be rebound for the entire unstarted pair prospectively before either case birth; record the exact common binding and immutable method/input hashes.
candidate_account.binding_required: host records an opaque nonsecret identity reference before actual case preparation; this declaration reserves the existing-account role and does not invent an account identifier
candidate_account.fresh_contexts: three fresh native Goal contexts per case; no copied reasoning histories; critic sees only current proposal, unresolved leads, brief/method/plan and same-case raw source captures; correction also sees candidate critique
candidate_account.load_policy: host freezes admission's own active-case/Goal occupancy and exposed account/provider load snapshot; external/unexposed load is UNKNOWN, never assumed zero

caps.stages: sequential; critic and correction consume the same family slots as research
caps.clock_birth: case birth is recorded before the first actual case-specific preparation/account execution binding/sandbox setup/source preparation/launch, whichever is earliest; each stage birth precedes its own preparation
caps.inclusive_timing: all preparation, waits, launch/activation delay, critique, corrections, cancel/termination and host work count; original case clock persists across stages and failures
caps.overrun: stop under host caps; unused stages remain unexecuted and incomplete cases cannot pass

birth_required: host records BEFORE actual case-specific preparation; reservation/template preparation time is not an activation receipt
input_packaging: copy only the assigned brief, thin plan, method card and stage TASK; later stages get only permitted same-case frozen current artifacts/raw source captures; no full planning directory mount
candidate_writes: optional within-case witness artifact with honest execution status
host_writes: native histories and stage artifact hashes
